pin_title: 7 Washing Machine & Laundry Freshness Buys Under £20 UK Homes Rely On
pin_hook: Keep machines fresh and clothes fuzz-free, all highly rated
pin_description: Washing machine and laundry freshness buys UK homes rely on: descaler tablets, lint removers, fabric shavers and limescale cleaners under £20. Easy laundry hacks and cleaning essentials for a fresher home. #ad #cleaningtips #laundryhacks #ukhomes #cleanhome
intro: A smelly washing machine or a bobbly jumper can undo a whole laundry day - these budget buys sort both in minutes.

products.name: BEAUTURAL Rechargeable Lint Remover
products.headline: Zaps bobbles off jumpers in seconds
products.why: A fast way to make tired knitwear look new again, with adjustable settings so it's gentle on delicate fabrics too.
products.photo_query: handheld fabric lint remover on sweater

products.name: Philips Lint Remover and Fabric Shaver
products.headline: A bestseller for refreshing pilled fabrics
products.why: Simple to use and gentle enough for jumpers, blankets and sofas, which is why it's stayed a go-to for so long.
products.photo_query: electric fabric shaver removing lint from clothing

products.name: Washing Machine Cleaner Descaler 24 Pack
products.headline: A months' supply of deep-clean tablets
products.why: Drops straight into an empty wash cycle to clear limescale, detergent build-up and musty smells from the drum.

products.name: Dettol Washing Machine Cleaner, Lemon
products.headline: Tackles hidden bacteria, not just limescale
products.why: A trusted name for keeping the drum and seals properly hygienic, with a fresh lemon scent left behind.

products.name: Calgon Hygiene Plus Washing Machine Cleaner
products.headline: Softens water and fights limescale together
products.why: Doubles up as a limescale protector and deep cleaner, which can help washes come out brighter over time.

products.name: Dr. Beckmann Service-it Power Descaler
products.headline: A cheap top-up between deep cleans
products.why: Handy sachets to run through the machine every so often to stop limescale building up in hard water areas.

products.name: Oust Dishwasher & Washing Machine Descaler
products.headline: One descaler for two hardworking appliances
products.why: Useful for anyone who'd rather buy one product for the washing machine and the dishwasher than two.
